verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since some open-source payment orchestration products can be self-hosted. The evidence, however, describes only Mollie-hosted services: hosted checkout, a cloud API, and an MCP server hosted at mcp.mollie.com that proxies the public API. Installable Magento and other e-commerce modules connect to Mollie's service and do not self-host its core, so there is no evidence of a self-hostable deployment.
